question: Which employees have clearance in Omega III? List employees' name.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "employees" AS SELECT "ygh" AS "ygh", "name" AS "name", "zw" AS "zw", "salary" AS "salary", "bz" AS "bz" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "clearances" AS SELECT "employee" AS "employee", "1" AS "1", "1_1" AS "1_1", "2" AS "2", "2_1" AS "2_1", "3" AS "3", "3_1" AS "3_1", "4" AS "4" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH emp_cols AS (
    SELECT 'employees' AS table_name, name AS column_name, type AS column_type
    FROM pragma_table_info('employees')
), clr_cols AS (
    SELECT 'clearances' AS table_name, name AS column_name, type AS column_type
    FROM pragma_table_info('clearances')
), target_emp AS (
    SELECT 'employees' AS table_name, * FROM (
        SELECT 'ygh' AS column_name, 'any' AS expected_type UNION ALL
        SELECT 'name', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT 'zw', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT 'salary', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT 'bz', 'any'
    )
), target_clr AS (
    SELECT 'clearances' AS table_name, * FROM (
        SELECT 'employee' AS column_name, 'any' AS expected_type UNION ALL
        SELECT '1', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT '1_1', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT '2', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT '2_1', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT '3', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT '3_1', 'any' UNION ALL
        SELECT '4', 'any'
    )
), actual AS (
    SELECT * FROM emp_cols
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM clr_cols
), target AS (
    SELECT * FROM target_emp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM target_clr
), coverage AS (
    SELECT t.table_name,
           t.column_name,
           CASE WHEN a.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS present,
           a.column_type
    FROM target t
    LEFT JOIN actual a
      ON a.table_name = t.table_name AND a.column_name = t.column_name
), extras AS (
    SELECT a.table_name, a.column_name, a.column_type
    FROM actual a
    LEFT JOIN target t
      ON a.table_name = t.table_name AND a.column_name = t.column_name
    WHERE t.column_name IS NULL
)
SELECT 'expected_coverage' AS section, * FROM coverage
UNION ALL
SELECT 'extra_columns' AS section, table_name, column_name, column_type FROM extras
ORDER BY section, table_name, column_name;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE employees AS SELECT CAST(ygh AS BIGINT) AS ygh, CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name, CAST(zw AS VARCHAR) AS zw, CAST(salary AS DOUBLE) AS salary, CAST(bz AS VARCHAR) AS bz FROM table_1
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE clearances AS SELECT CAST(employee AS VARCHAR) AS employee, CAST("1" AS BIGINT) AS "1", CAST("1_1" AS BIGINT) AS "1_1", CAST("2" AS BIGINT) AS "2", CAST("2_1" AS BIGINT) AS "2_1", CAST("3" AS BIGINT) AS "3", CAST("3_1" AS BIGINT) AS "3_1", CAST("4" AS BIGINT) AS "4" FROM table_3

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH emp AS (
  SELECT name AS col, type FROM pragma_table_info('employees')
), clr AS (
  SELECT name AS col, type FROM pragma_table_info('clearances')
), emp_expect AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('ygh'),('name'),('zw'),('salary'),('bz')) AS t(col)
), clr_expect AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('employee'),('1'),('1_1'),('2'),('2_1'),('3'),('3_1'),('4')) AS t(col)
), emp_status AS (
  SELECT 'employees' AS table_name,
         e.col,
         CASE WHEN a.col IS NOT NULL THEN 'present' ELSE 'missing' END AS status
  FROM emp_expect e
  LEFT JOIN emp a ON a.col = e.col
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'employees' AS table_name,
         a.col,
         'extra' AS status
  FROM emp a LEFT JOIN emp_expect e ON e.col = a.col
  WHERE e.col IS NULL
), clr_status AS (
  SELECT 'clearances' AS table_name,
         e.col,
         CASE WHEN a.col IS NOT NULL THEN 'present' ELSE 'missing' END AS status
  FROM clr_expect e
  LEFT JOIN clr a ON a.col = e.col
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'clearances' AS table_name,
         a.col,
         'extra' AS status
  FROM clr a LEFT JOIN clr_expect e ON e.col = a.col
  WHERE e.col IS NULL
)
SELECT * FROM emp_status
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM clr_status
ORDER BY table_name, col;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT e.name AS employee_name
FROM employees e
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(e.zw,'')) LIKE '%captain%'
   OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.zw,'')) LIKE '%manager%'
ORDER BY employee_name

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH clr AS (
  SELECT employee, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(employee), '') AS VARCHAR) AS emp_text,
         TRY_CAST(employee AS BIGINT) AS emp_id,
         COALESCE(3,3) AS tier_col,
         "3" AS omega3
  FROM clearances
  WHERE employee IS NOT NULL
),
-- Match by ID
by_id AS (
  SELECT e.name
  FROM employees e
  JOIN clr c
    ON c.emp_id = e.ygh
  WHERE TRY_CAST(c.omega3 AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(c.omega3 AS BIGINT) <> 0
),
-- Match by exact name
by_name AS (
  SELECT e.name
  FROM employees e
  JOIN clr c
    ON LOWER(c.emp_text) = LOWER(e.name)
  WHERE TRY_CAST(c.omega3 AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(c.omega3 AS BIGINT) <> 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT name AS employee_name
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM by_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM by_name
)
ORDER BY employee_name

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT e.name AS employee_name
FROM employees e
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(e.zw, '')) LIKE '%captain%'
ORDER BY employee_name
S:
# Assumption: No per-employee mapping in clearances; column "3" indicates Omega III tier exists, but only job titles suggest holders. We align with prior valid result from employees table.
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT e.name AS employee_name
FROM employees e
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(e.zw, '')) LIKE '%captain%'
ORDER BY employee_name
"""
